name-missing: Enter a name for the paycheck.
clearing-name-missing: Enter a name for the new clearing account.
clearing-account-not-open-on-budget: The clearing account must be an open on-budget account.
duplicate-deposit-account: Each deposit must go to a different account.
transfer-account-missing: Choose an account for each transfer deduction.
deposit-account-missing: Choose an account for each deposit.
deposit-to-clearing-account: A deposit cannot go to the clearing account.
days-early-invalid: Business days early must be a whole number from 0 to 10.
multiple-remainders: Only one deposit can be the remainder.
deposits-do-not-add-up: Deposits must add up to net pay or include a remainder.
no-deposits: Add at least one direct deposit.
